exposure: Prolonged early antibiotics (>=5 days of antibiotic therapy started at <=72 h of age)
cohort: The study included 5730 infants from 13 centers, born without a major birth defect between 2008-2014, weighing 401-1000 grams, at 22-28 weeks gestation, and who survived at least 5 days without culture-confirmed infection, NEC, or spontaneous intestinal perforation.
finding: Prolonged early antibiotic therapy was not significantly associated with increased odds of death or necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC).
